notes:
POLO 2.4.1 — Language & Control Center

- Spanish and Dutch interface expansion across the RAM/Storage and Windows Control Center screens.
- Yellow update notice remains visible across app restarts until a newer version is installed; it links to Update Center.
- Six additional documented Edge controls for tabs, New Tab content, prompts and privacy. Each has readback, confirmation and exact rollback state.
- Faster Windows scans: native administrator check replaces a PowerShell launch.
- UI translation updates changed nodes rather than rescanning the entire app after every render.

POLO does not claim universal FPS or ping gains. Browser policy effects depend on Edge version and profile type. Unsupported Windows and hardware controls remain unavailable.
